description: This file provides sandbox security validation functions for Docker configurations, including path validation, network mode restrictions, and profile checks, to enforce security policies at runtime.

methods.name: parseBindSpec
methods.description: Parses a bind mount string into source and target components.

methods.name: parseBindSourcePath
methods.description: Extracts the source path from a bind mount string.

methods.name: parseBindTargetPath
methods.description: Extracts the target path from a bind mount string.

methods.name: normalizeHostPath
methods.description: Normalizes a POSIX path by resolving '.', '..', collapsing slashes, and removing trailing '/'.

methods.name: getBlockedBindReason
methods.description: Determines if a bind mount targets or uses blocked paths or non-absolute source paths.

methods.name: getBlockedReasonForSourcePath
methods.description: Checks if a normalized source path is blocked or covers system root.

methods.name: getBlockedHostPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of host paths that are blocked, including system paths and user home subpaths.

methods.name: getBlockedHomeRoots
methods.description: Returns normalized home directory roots that are considered blocked.

methods.name: normalizeAllowedRoots
methods.description: Normalizes and expands allowed source root paths.

methods.name: isPathInsidePosix
methods.description: Checks if a target path is inside a given root path.

methods.name: getOutsideAllowedRootsReason
methods.description: Determines if a source path is outside the allowed roots.

methods.name: getReservedTargetReason
methods.description: Checks if a bind target path targets a reserved container path.

methods.name: enforceSourcePathPolicy
methods.description: Enforces policies on source paths, throwing errors if blocked or outside allowed roots.

methods.name: formatBindBlockedError
methods.description: Formats an error message based on the reason a bind is blocked.

methods.name: validateBindMounts
methods.description: Validates a list of bind mounts, throwing errors if any are unsafe.

methods.name: validateNetworkMode
methods.description: Validates the network mode, blocking 'host' and container namespace joins.

methods.name: validateSeccompProfile
methods.description: Checks if the seccomp profile is blocked.

methods.name: validateApparmorProfile
methods.description: Checks if the AppArmor profile is blocked.

methods.name: validateSandboxSecurity
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of sandbox security settings including binds, network, seccomp, and AppArmor profiles.
